interpretation: Only fully evaluated cells from the current comparison matrix are included.
Text inter-token intervals are row-weighted recorded decode intervals, including graph capture effects. They exclude prefill and queue waiting.
Admitted batch size is the number of requests in a recorded batch, not the number of rows still decoding at each token step.
Finite service latency includes prefill, cache operations and readout. It is neither text ITL nor GPU kernel time.
All saved sessions are included. After preemption, service work can include interrupted attempts whose task result was not committed; these aggregates must not be treated as unique-task throughput.
Missing intervals remain null. These observations compare executed workloads; they are not matched-input kernel speedup measurements.
TTFT uses recorded per-call backend first-token latency; request queue time is recorded separately. LatentMAS includes latent-role computation before its first visible token.

Lifecycle throughput divides total work by summed completed inference-session runtime on one shared-config TP replica. Sessions include tools, queue waits and graph capture; model loading is separate. Concurrent replicas are accounted by summed replica-seconds, not summed sample latencies.
Full-cell lifecycle throughput remains null when any session timing is missing or completed task identities do not match the evaluated task set exactly once.

Logical input tokens include reused context; they are not actual prefill computation. Text output tokens exclude program-rendered structure and finite choices. Finite model-scored fields are counted separately; deterministic single-option dispatch is excluded.
